Environmental Services Supervisor (Nights)
St. Brigid Medical Center · Dayton, OH

About St. Brigid
St. Brigid Medical Center is a 310-bed teaching hospital and a proud part of the Miami Valley community for over 90 years. Our mission is compassionate care for every patient.

The role
We're looking for an Environmental Services Supervisor to lead our overnight EVS team of 12. You'll make sure patient rooms, operating rooms and public areas are clean, safe and ready, and you'll help keep the department survey-ready.

Responsibilities
- Supervise and coach overnight environmental services staff
- Build staff schedules and arrange coverage for call-offs
- Inspect patient rooms and discharge cleans for quality
- Train new team members on infection prevention and chemical safety
- Track supplies and place orders

Requirements
- At least 3 years of environmental services or custodial experience, preferably in a healthcare setting
- Experience leading or supervising a team of custodial or housekeeping staff
- Working knowledge of infection prevention and cleaning standards in a hospital
- Experience building staff schedules and covering call-offs
- Proficiency with Microsoft Office (Word, Excel and Outlook)
- High school diploma or GED

Preferred
- CHEST or another environmental services certification
- Experience preparing for Joint Commission surveys
- Bilingual English/Spanish

Pay and benefits
$54,000 – $62,000 per year plus a night shift differential. Medical, dental and vision insurance, 403(b) with employer match, tuition reimbursement and paid time off.

Schedule
Sunday–Thursday, 10:00 p.m. – 6:30 a.m.

St. Brigid Medical Center is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other basis covered by law.

How to apply: submit your resume through careers.stbrigid.example by November 15.
